title: {p} Piccata with {v}
steps: Pat the {p} dry and season with the {spice}. Sear in a hot pan until golden and {doneness}, then set aside on a clean plate.
Cook the {v} in the same pan until tender-crisp, then set aside with the {p}.
Pour the {sauce} and a squeeze of lemon into the pan, scrape up the browned bits and simmer until slightly thick.
Return the {p} and {v} to the pan to coat, and serve over the {s}.
tip: Lemon and stock make the pan sauce, so you need very little butter or cream.
